title: Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo e-Facebook ku-Gallery Yefoni
description: Landa amavidiyo e-Facebook uwafake ku-Gallery ye-Android ne-iPhone ngaphandle kwe-app. Kopisha ilinki yevidiyo, uyinamathisele ku-I Need Save, ulondoloze.
body:
I-Facebook igcwele amavidiyo athakazelisayo, kusukela kumaresiphi okupheka, amathiphu okulima ingadi, iziqeshana zemidlalo, kuya kumavidiyo ahlekisayo avela emaqenjini owathandayo. Ngeshwa, ayikho inkinobho eyakhelwe ngaphakathi yokuwalondoloza ngqo ku-gallery. Kule ndatshana uzofunda indlela yokulanda amavidiyo e-Facebook uwafake ku-gallery yefoni yakho usebenzisa i-I Need Save, ithuluzi lamahhala elisebenza kuwebhu ongalisebenzisa ngaphandle kwe-app nangaphandle kokungena ngemvume.

Yini Oyidingayo?

Akukuningi okudingekayo:

  • Ifoni noma ikhompyutha ene-browser ne-inthanethi.
  • Ilinki yevidiyo ye-Facebook evela kokuthunyelwe okusesidlangalaleni.
  • Isikhala esincane endaweni yokugcina yedivayisi yakho.

Yilokho kuphela. Akudingeki uvule i-akhawunti ku-I Need Save, futhi akudingeki ufake imininingwane yakho yokungena ku-Facebook.

Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo e-Facebook Efonini

Landela lezi zinyathelo, kungaba ku-Android noma ku-iPhone:

  1. Vula i-app ye-Facebook bese uthola ividiyo ofuna ukuyilondoloza.
  2. Thepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana (Share) ngaphansi kwevidiyo.
  3. Khetha Kopisha ilinki (Copy link).
  4. Vula i-browser, bese uvakashela i-ineedsave.com.
  5. Namathisela ilinki ebhokisini elikhona, noma uthephe inkinobho ethi Namathisela.
  6. Cindezela okuthi Landa bese ulinda kuvele uhlu lwezinketho.
  7. Khetha ikhwalithi yevidiyo oyifunayo. Ukulanda kuzoqala.

Kwamanye amavidiyo, inkinobho izoqala ibonise okuthi Iyalungisa…. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho ividiyo idinga ukucutshungulwa kuqala, isibonelo uma ividiyo nomsindo kuhlanganiswa noma i-stream iguqulelwa ku-MP4. Vele ulinde, ngoba ukulanda kuzoqala ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ifayela selilungile.

Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo e-Facebook Kukhompyutha

Ku-laptop noma ku-PC, izinyathelo ziyafana. Vula i-Facebook ku-browser, chofoza ividiyo oyifunayo, bese ukopisha ilinki yayo kumenyu ethi Yabelana noma ku-address bar. Vula ikhasi lokulanda kuthebhu entsha, namathisela ilinki, chofoza okuthi Landa, bese ukhetha inketho ekhona. Ifayela lizolondolozwa kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe).

Izinzuzo Zokulanda Nge-I Need Save

  • Kumahhala futhi akudingi app. Vele uvule isayithi ku-browser yefoni noma yekhompyutha.
  • Akudingi ukungena ngemvume. Akudingeki ufake imininingwane ye-akhawunti yakho ye-Facebook noma kuphi.
  • Isebenza nakwezinye izinkundla. Ngaphandle kwe-Facebook, ungalondoloza namavidiyo avela ku-TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), nakwezinye izinkundla ezisekelwayo.
  • Kulula ukuyisebenzisa. Isayithi litholakala ngezilimi ezingu-93, kuhlanganise nesiZulu.

Ukukhetha Ikhwalithi Yevidiyo Efanele

Ngemuva kokuthi ilinki icutshunguliwe, i-I Need Save ikubonisa izinketho ezimbalwa. Okuvelayo kungahluka kuye ngevidiyo ngayinye:

  • Ividiyo ngamakhwalithi ahlukene, isibonelo 360p, 720p, noma 1080p, kuye ngevidiyo yangempela.
  • Umsindo ngekhwalithi yangempela noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe evidiyweni.
  • Isithombe / Isithonjana sevidiyo leyo.

Ngokuvamile, i-1080p inika isithombe esicace kakhulu, i-720p ilinganisela phakathi kwekhwalithi nobukhulu befayela, kanti i-360p yonga kakhulu idatha nendawo yokugcina. Incazelo ephelele ikundatshana ethi umehluko wekhwalithi yevidiyo engu-360p, 720p, ne-1080p.

Ukuze Ividiyo Ivele ku-Gallery Yefoni

Lena yingxenye evame ukudida abantu. Ngemuva kokuthi ukulanda sekuqediwe, ividiyo ayiveli ngaso sonke isikhathi ngokushesha ku-gallery. Nansi incazelo.

Ku-Android

Ividiyo ilondolozwa kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). I-app ye-Gallery ivamise ukuyibonisa, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi kuthatha isikhashana. Uma ingakaveli, linda kancane noma uvule ifolda ethi Downloads nge-app yokuphatha amafayela.

Ku-iPhone naku-iPad

Uma ulanda nge-Safari, ividiyo ingena ku-app ethi Files (Amafayela), kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). Ukuze uyidlulisele ku-app ethi Photos (Izithombe):

  1. Vula i-app ethi Files bese ungena kufolda ethi Downloads.
  2. Thepha ividiyo osanda kuyilanda.
  3. Thepha inkinobho ethi Share (Yabelana).
  4. Khetha Save Video (Londoloza Ividiyo).

Manje ividiyo isiku-gallery yakho futhi ungayidlala njengamanye amavidiyo. Amafayela e-MP4 avela ku-I Need Save anobude besikhathi obulungile, ngakho adlala kahle kuma-app e-gallery.

Ithiphu: Uma uvame ukulanda amavidiyo, hlanza ifolda ethi Downloads njalo ukuze indawo yokugcina yefoni yakho ingagcwali ngokushesha.

Ividiyo Ye-Facebook Ayilandeki?

Ezinye izinhlobo zokuqukethwe azikwazi ukulandwa:

  • Amavidiyo avela kuma-akhawunti noma emaqenjini ayimfihlo.
  • Okuqukethwe okubonakala kuphela ngemuva kokungena ngemvume.
  • Amavidiyo akhawulelwe ezifundeni ezithile.

Qiniseka futhi ukuthi ilinki oyinamathiselayo iyilinki yevidiyo, hhayi ilinki yekhasi noma yephrofayela. Uma ungenaso isiqiniseko, yikopishe futhi enkinobhweni ethi Yabelana yevidiyo.

Kuphephile Futhi Kunomthwalo

Ividiyo idluliswa ngqo isuka ku-Facebook iye kudivayisi yakho futhi ayigcinwa kuseva ye-I Need Save. Noma kunjalo, sebenzisa okulandile ukuze kube ngokwakho kuphela. Hlonipha amalungelo obunikazi (copyright) omdali wevidiyo: cela imvume ngaphambi kokuyiphinda uyithumele futhi ubalule umnikazi wayo wangempela.

Imibuzo Evame Ukubuzwa

Ngingawalanda yini amavidiyo e-Facebook ngaphandle kwe-app?

Yebo. I-I Need Save isebenza ngqo ku-browser, ngakho akudingeki ufake noma iyiphi i-app.

Kungani ividiyo ingaveli ngokushesha ku-gallery?

Ku-Android, i-Gallery kwesinye isikhathi idinga isikhashana ukuze ibonise amafayela amasha. Ku-iPhone, ividiyo iqala ingene ku-app ethi Files, bese kudingeka ukhethe okuthi Save Video ukuze ingene ku-Photos.

Ngingathatha umsindo wodwa?

Yebo. Khetha inketho ethi Umsindo, kungaba ngekhwalithi yangempela noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps.
